tables.name: schedule-action
tables.description: HBase table tracking scheduled/executed actions. Uses two row key shapes: an hour-bucket index row (<yyyy-mm-dd_hh>) and a per-action detail row (<cif>_<chrono_sequence_journal>_<yyyy-mm-dd>_<execution_time_id>).

columns.name: rowkey
columns.description: Row key can take one of two shapes, each nested below with the column family that applies to it.

children.name: yyyy-mm-dd_hh
children.description: Index-row shape, e.g. 2026-08-24_14

children.name: index
children.description: Column family on hour-bucket index rows. Each qualifier points to a detail row in the info family.

children.name: qualifier
children.description: The qualifier itself is the pointer -- it contains the row key needed to look up the matching detail row in the info family.

children.name: cif_chrono_sequence_journal_yyyy-mm-dd_execution_time_id
children.description: Row key of the corresponding detail row in the info family, e.g. 16278_260716112458323023093001A_2026-07-17_01

children.name: info
children.description: Column family on detail rows.

children.name: qualifier
children.description: Real HBase qualifiers are compound (<date>|<unique_record_id>|<field_name>) so each qualifier string is unique per record; the field names below are the known/recurring business attributes extracted from that qualifier. Some fields (the execution-result ones) only appear once an action has finished running, not while it's still pending.

children.name: action
children.description: Action type/status code, e.g. C (created), U (updated)

children.name: chrono_sequence_journal
children.description: Chronological sequence journal identifier

children.name: customer_id
children.description: Customer identifier (matches cif in the row key)

children.name: execution_time_id
children.description: Identifier for the scheduled execution time slot

children.name: last_updated_datetime
children.description: Timestamp this record was last updated, with timezone offset

children.name: last_updated_description
children.description: Free-text description of the last update event (e.g. originating API call)

children.name: last_updated_other_info
children.description: Additional structured info about the last update

children.name: last_updated_user_id
children.description: User or system that performed the last update, e.g. INTERNAL

children.name: new_chronological_sequence
children.description: Updated chronological sequence value

children.name: new_effective_date
children.description: Effective date for the (re)scheduled action

children.name: new_execution_count
children.description: Number of times this action has been executed

children.name: new_is_timeout
children.description: Whether the action timed out

children.name: new_service_name
children.description: Name of the downstream service invoked, e.g. ACCOUNT

children.name: new_status
children.description: Current status of the action, e.g. pending, done

children.name: new_system_note
children.description: Free-text system note, often empty

children.name: new_thread
children.description: Thread/worker count or identifier handling the action

children.name: new_transaction_job_id
children.description: Job identifier for the underlying transaction

children.name: running_date
children.description: Date the action actually ran

children.name: service_id
children.description: Identifier for the scheduled service instance

children.name: x_job_id
children.description: Cross-system job identifier

children.name: x_request_id
children.description: Cross-system request identifier

children.name: new_elapsed_time
children.description: Elapsed execution time in milliseconds (present once execution finishes)

children.name: new_error_code
children.description: Error code returned on failure (present only on failure)

children.name: new_error_desc
children.description: Error description returned on failure (present only on failure)

children.name: new_execution_finish_datetime
children.description: Timestamp execution finished, with timezone offset (present once execution finishes)

children.name: new_execution_start_datetime
children.description: Timestamp execution started, with timezone offset (present once execution finishes)

children.name: new_result
children.description: Execution result, e.g. fail (present once execution finishes)
